mapping.note: Same math as LlamaRMSNorm, but the class is Qwen2RMSNorm, which the repo's assert and dispatch do not accept
GQA: k/v have 256 outputs vs 1536 for q; smoothing takes the column max over all three, so shapes are fine
Llama has no q/k/v biases; the method's W8A8Linear keeps biases in fp16
tied (tie_word_embeddings=true); the method leaves both in fp16

differences.detail: The repo selects layers by isinstance on OPT/Bloom/Falcon/Llama/Mistral/Mixtral classes. Qwen2DecoderLayer, Qwen2RMSNorm, Qwen2Attention and Qwen2MLP match none of them, so smooth_lm silently applies no smoothing and quantize_model does not reach the Llama path. Map Qwen2 onto the Llama-like path: same two smoothing sites (input_layernorm -> q/k/v, post_attention_layernorm -> gate/up), and all seven decoder linears to W8A8.

q/k/v carry biases. Smoothing scales weight columns (the input side) and the bias is added after the matmul, so biases stay unchanged (method.md Invariants). Keep them fp16 as W8A8Linear does; save them alongside the int8 weight.
Embeddings are tied to lm_head. SmoothQuant never touches either, so the tie survives. The saved artifact must keep lm_head tied/fp16; vLLM export rejects int8 embeddings or heads.

The repo's Llama-like path only holds a fake-quant fp16 model in memory (W8A8Linear stores dequantized fp16 weights); its real-int8 save is OPT-only and needs torch-int. Saving that gives no VRAM win. The port must save int8 `<linear>.weight` [N,K] plus a float per-output-channel `<linear>.weight_scale` [N,1], fp16 biases and smoothed fp16 norms, write quantization_config.json (W8A8, per_channel weights, per_token dynamic activations, smoothing folded offline), and ship an inference adapter that rebuilds W8A8 linears from int8 + scale with per-token dynamic activation quantization.

Calibration: use the repo's Pile validation data (mit-han-lab/pile-val-backup val.jsonl.zst, seed 42, 512 samples x 512 tokens). Migration strength: Qwen2 is Llama-like; start at the repo's Llama-family alpha 0.85.

notes: Positive recipe library/contributions/Qwen_Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct__g5.2xlarge__SmoothQuant.json: same repo commit, packed int8, PPL ratio 1.051 on A10G, vLLM w8a8_int8 export passed (PPL ratio 1.015). Its port bundle was not stored (port: null), so this spec is rebuilt from the paper and repo. The packed int8 + per-channel scale layout matches what that run published.
